key_reasoning.reason: Shared foundations gained a mobile branch (App shell, Navigation, Sidebar, PageLayout, Popup, Table, Card, Tabs) plus the chat page and page-level adjustments in 9 feature areas. New abstractions: mobile shell state in appInfoStore, MobileTopBar, TableCardList, useMobileSidebar, useIsMobileLayout.

Raised from M to L: a second feedback round added requirements (chat toolbar, AI message metadata, skill form, katas, analytics, login), and the review surfaced behaviour the Figma does not define (tours on mobile, card-mode sorting and selection, state across the breakpoint), each needing a decision and rework.

Confirmed L: the review found breakpoint-crossing desyncs in the chat panels and interaction gaps in card mode, fixed with small effect-dependency and handler changes. Desktop class sets stayed identical, and the existing suites (desktop-only through the matchMedia stub) pass unchanged.

84 files: 62 production source files, 12 test and test-utility files, index.html, tailwind.config.ts and 8 SDLC artifacts; 12 new files, among them mobileLayout.ts, useIsMobileLayout.ts, MobileTopBar.tsx, useNavigationExpanded.ts, TableCardList.tsx, useMobileSidebar.ts and the mobileLayout test helper. +3127/-326 lines, part of which is re-indentation in Table.tsx and ChatPage.tsx.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from L (4) to XL (5): shared foundations (Table, Sidebar, PageLayout, Popup, Card, Navigation) are rendered by nearly every page.
